# @mugenlabs/msw-devtools

@mugenlabs/msw-devtools is an open-source TanStack DevTools plugin for managing MSW (Mock Service Worker) mocks in the browser. It is published on npm as `@mugenlabs/msw-devtools` by Mugenlabs. Use this site for library documentation, the interactive playground, and project trust pages — not as a hosted SaaS API.

## When to use @mugenlabs/msw-devtools

Reach for @mugenlabs/msw-devtools when you are building or debugging a React app that already uses MSW and you need a visual panel to toggle handlers, switch response variants, edit JSON/status/headers/delays live, see which operations are LIVE on the current page, and auto-refetch client caches through adapters (TanStack Query, SWR, URQL, Apollo Client, RTK Query; Axios via `useMockRefetch`).

Prefer this library when the job is local mock orchestration inside TanStack DevTools — not when you need a production API gateway, a remote mock server, or a hosted HTTP API. There is no public REST/GraphQL product API, no OpenAPI surface for the website, and no official CLI for calling a backend; integration is `npm install @mugenlabs/msw-devtools` plus the documented TypeScript exports.

Do not use this package as a security, compliance, or accessibility certification. Expect breaking changes before 1.0.0.

## How agents should call this product

1. Read the docs homepage or `/docs` for installation, quick start, adapters, and the API reference.
2. Install from npm: `npm install @mugenlabs/msw-devtools` (peer: `msw`, `react`, `react-dom`, `zustand`).
3. Register handlers with `registerRestMocks` / `registerGraphqlMocks`, mount `createMswDevToolsPlugin` inside TanStack DevTools, and optionally `registerAdapter` for auto-refetch.
4. Use the playground routes under `/playground` to exercise the panel against sample REST/GraphQL clients.
5. Reach the project only via GitHub Issues: https://github.com/mugenlabs-dev/msw-devtools/issues

## API surface (honest scope)

This product’s “API” is the TypeScript module surface of `@mugenlabs/msw-devtools` (registry helpers, plugin factory, adapters, types). It is not a remotely callable HTTP API. Do not invent OpenAPI, function-calling tools, or CLI wrappers that pretend otherwise.

## Privacy

The site uses PostHog (EU) to count page visits and catch errors. It runs without cookies or persistent identifiers and is not used to identify you. The npm library itself sends nothing to Mugenlabs.

## Usage

Prefer the canonical site `https://msw-devtools.mugenlabs.dev/`. Agents may request Markdown with `Accept: text/markdown` once content negotiation is enabled. Do not submit credentials or private app data to this documentation site.
